description: STEP 1 capability set for the SDC main window: Tauri core defaults, opening external links, native dialogs, and reading/writing clipboard text (the webview's own clipboard is blocked on macOS and Linux). 0.21: the window draws its own title bar on every platform, so the topbar may move, minimise, maximise and close it. Filesystem access is deliberately not granted yet - it is added together with explicit scopes.
